claims.claim: Implemented content-addressed correction integration in src/aios_renew/correction_integration.py with derive_integration_identity, integrate_correction, and fail-closed validation requiring exact canonical remote main SHA and exact unique cumulative RESULT tip before candidate materialization; replay of identical parameters is idempotent while mismatched or missing remote lifecycle evidence fails closed.

Implemented conflict-free merge tree calculation in integrate_correction via plumbing commit-tree without altering working tree, HEAD, or persistent branches; produces deterministic two-parent merge commit [cumulative_tip_sha, authorized_main_sha] and fails closed without creating authoritative refs if merge conflicts, ambiguous bases, or missing objects occur.

Enforced fail-closed remote integration publication requiring push verification to refs/heads/aios/integration/<integration_id>; resolve_valid_integration ensures missing, moved, or failed remote integration refs prevent integration success, Unified State readiness, and remediation admission.

Extended prospective remediation execution base grammar to bind integration identity, cumulative tip RUN/SHA, authorized main SHA, and candidate SHA; sets remediation Run.base_sha to the integration candidate commit while preserving semantic predecessor and maintaining backward compatibility with non-integrated execution bases.

Unified State, Correction Preflight, remediation execution, and Publisher independently consume and validate the same exact integrated execution base; subsequent movements of canonical main or cumulative tip invalidate readiness and return INTEGRATION_REQUIRED.

Preserved TASK-141 repaired-PRIMARY semantic-root frontier derivation in unified_state.py and composed it seamlessly with correction integration so operational ancestors and semantic review roots remain distinct and compatible.

Provided operator command aios integrate-correction and regression coverage reproducing the TASK-140 topology: deterministically transitions from INTEGRATION_REQUIRED to remediation-ready after explicit valid integration without invoking an Executor during the integration operation.

Configured integrated remediation changed-files and scope accounting to evaluate diffs against the integration candidate SHA as the baseline, preventing changes already present on current main from being attributed to the Executor.

Updated src/aios_renew/publication.py to independently verify remote integration refs, parent commits, clean merge tree, cumulative RESULT tip, authorized main, and candidate ancestry prior to publishing, while maintaining full compatibility with non-integrated lifecycles.

Verified comprehensive test suites in tests/test_correction_integration.py, tests/test_operator.py, tests/test_operator_correction_preflight.py, tests/test_operator_unified_state.py, and tests/test_publication.py; working tree is clean with zero trailing whitespace or lint issues, zero unresolved items, and production modifications strictly restricted to authorized scope.
